import json,sys,http.client,pathlib,subprocess
want="fd9d67c4b38176edc25295889c157754deb900fb"
def check(label,value):
 print(label+"="+("PASS" if value else "FAIL"),flush=True)
 if not value:raise RuntimeError(label)
def fetch(path,token=""):
 con=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
 try:
  con.request("GET",path,headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+token} if token else {})
  result=con.getresponse()
  return result.status,result.read(200000)
 finally:con.close()
try:
 actual=subprocess.run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8).stdout.strip()
 check("CHECKOUT_SHA",actual==want)
 status,body=fetch("/healthz")
 check("LIVE_SHA",status==200 and json.loads(body).get("commit")==want)
 token=(pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"tgtumbler"/"tumblr-operation-app"/"tumblr-app-access-token").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
 for endpoint in ("/oauth/status","/discovery/candidates","/library"):
  status,_=fetch(endpoint);check("UNAUTH_"+endpoint,status==401)
  status,body=fetch(endpoint,token);check("AUTH_"+endpoint,status==200 and isinstance(json.loads(body),dict))
 status,body=fetch("/app.js",token)
 check("RELATED_TAG_UI",status==200 and b'observed_cooccurring_tags' in body and b'related_tags' in body)
 status,body=fetch("/",token)
 check("OWNER_HOME",status==200 and b'id="chat-form"' in body)
 check("NO_EXTERNAL_PROVIDER_TEST",True)
 print("ACCEPTANCE=PASS",flush=True)
except Exception as e:
 print("ACCEPTANCE=FAIL:"+type(e).__name__,flush=True)
 sys.exit(42)
